patch.value: Keep dependency bullets when a closed item covers a release window

Review-thread follow-up from the 2026-11-14 sweep PR rebase: the pinned pm-changelog generator renders the git-derived Dependencies section only for windows without closed tracker items, so evidenced closures covering a window replace its published dependency bullets. Consider opting the changelog generation into dependency-updates rendering so published dependency entries survive alongside item notes.
A decision records whether changelog:full should render git-derived dependency bullets alongside item-covered windows; any script change regenerates and checks the changelog and passes release gates

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Verified the unresolved dependency-note review against published tag v2026.11.11: dependency PRs 216, 214, 210, 211, 212 are present there. The configured changelog:full omits --dependency-updates; the pinned generator enriches item-covered windows only with that option. A persistent fix requires package-script or generator changes, outside the authorized tracker/changelog scope. Reused this follow-up; no review reply or resolution was sent.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Closure follow-up: changelog dependency updates. Verify against current main and the existing PR head before recording the result.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: The closure verifier allows tracker files and CHANGELOG.md only. This follow-up explicitly calls for package.json flags so the verifier will still report the manifest as out of scope.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: The inherited reconciled receipt 8751e3d1-ec58-487a-917c-3b7dc9a8dcf6 for pm-linear-hb2g predates the current main snapshot. The item and history are byte-identical to current main, which carries no receipt or history reference to it. Pinned reconcile dry-run refused the old receipt with no_receipt_set_proves_snapshot. Restoring main's active receipt set made the same reconcile dry-run report ok and zero pending receipts, and pinned validation passed. The old receipt remains in Git history.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Package changelog generation, verification and release notes use --dependency-updates, including checks that delegate to the full generator. With the same tracker and fetched tags, the original manifest omitted published dependency bullets for #210, #211, #212, #214, #216. The flag restored all of them. Changelog byte check and release notes rendering passed.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: The dependency-note switch belongs in fix/changelog-keep-dependency-updates. Restore this closure branch's package scripts to main and regenerate with the unflagged invocation. The flag PR will restore the dependency notes separately.

value.author: codex-agent

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Use the opt-in in every package changelog invocation, including delegated verification. The same-tag comparison and generated release headings verify the previously published dependency PRs: 210,211,212,214,216.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: The linked release notes command, direct release notes and package identity test passed. With the flag enabled, the generated ledger contains all identified published dependency PRs at their release headings. Changelog verification is repeated after this tracker update.

value.text: The release-workflow regression now protects the dependency flag on every package changelog entry point and preserves delegated verification where configured. Removing only the flag from the package scripts in a disposable copy fails this regression. The fixed release-workflow suite passes.
